about.title: Beverly Hills Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Beverly Hills sees a steady flow of traffic moving between Los Angeles's westside and the corridors that cut through it, and with that traffic comes collisions. Public records show 378 injury collisions and 524 people hurt in the most recent final reporting year, with reported crashes clustering on Thursday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. Wilshire Boulevard, Olympic Boulevard, N Santa Monica Boulevard, and Sunset Boulevard carry the highest volume of reported crashes in the city. If you were injured in one of these collisions, the choices you make in the days afterward matter. Insurance adjusters move fast, and evidence like skid marks, vehicle damage, and witness memory fades quickly. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and we can put you in touch with an independent personal injury attorney in Los Angeles County who takes cases on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before You Talk to the Insurer

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock Is Shorter Than You Think
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident lawsuit in California, but if a government vehicle or roadway defect was involved, that window can shrink to as little as six months. Waiting to sort out fault could quietly cost you your claim.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Be Used Against You
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning your recovery can be reduced by whatever percentage you're found responsible, even if that's just 10%. An early recorded statement to the other driver's insurer can be twisted to shift blame onto you before you've even seen the full picture.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages, No Fee Unless You Recover
items.desc: California doesn't limit compensation for pain, suffering, or loss of enjoyment of life in car accident cases. Attorneys in LawProactive's network work on contingency, so there's no upfront cost and no fee unless money is recovered on your behalf.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement?
items.answer: It's best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurance adjusters are trained to ask questions that can be used to minimize your claim or shift fault onto you. An independent attorney can help you understand what you're required to share and what you're not.

items.question: What should I do right after a crash on a street like Wilshire or Olympic Boulevard?
items.answer: If you're able, document the scene with photos, get contact information from witnesses, and seek medical attention even if injuries seem minor. Reported crashes on these corridors often involve multiple vehicles, so preserving evidence quickly matters before it's lost or memories fade. Reporting the crash and following up with medical records also helps support any later claim.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service that connects you with an independent personal injury attorney in your area. Attorneys in the network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation.
